# Contributing to UI Lovelace Minimalist Cards

Thanks for helping! The full guide lives in the root
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — this file only points there so GitHub
shows the right guidelines when you open an issue or pull request.

In short:

1. Fork the repo and create a branch from `main`.
2. Change cards, chips or popups in `editable-cards/src/` (Lit + TypeScript).
3. Run `bash scripts/build-hacs.sh` and test the card in Home Assistant.
4. Open a pull request against `main`.

> This is an **unofficial** fork of
> [UI Lovelace Minimalist](https://github.com/UI-Lovelace-Minimalist/UI).
> Please report problems with these cards here, not in the upstream repository.

All contributions are under the [MIT License](../LICENSE).
